headline: Nagarjuna Agri Tech Q2FY27 Results
summary: Nagarjuna Agri Tech reported a standalone net profit of ₹38.74 lakh for Q2FY27, down from ₹47.47 lakh YoY. Consolidated revenue rose to ₹2,639.99 lakh.

headline: Ashoka Buildcon wins L-1 bid for ₹1,465 crore NHAI project
summary: Ashoka Buildcon has emerged as the lowest bidder (L-1) for a ₹1,465 crore NHAI EPC project in Gujarat, marking a significant order win for the infrastructure firm.

headline: Signatureglobal subsidiary wins ₹194.19 crore land bid
summary: Signatureglobal (India)'s subsidiary Maa Vaishno Net-tech emerged as the successful bidder for 474.66 acres of land in Raigad, Maharashtra for ₹194.19 crore.

headline: Lineage Power wins ₹194.06 million BESS order
summary: Pace Digitek's subsidiary Lineage Power has received a purchase order worth ₹194.06 million from Insolare Energy for a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS).

headline: Khazanchi Jewellers targets ₹5,000 crore revenue by 2030
summary: Khazanchi Jewellers targets ₹5,000 crore in revenue by 2030, aiming for 25-30% annual growth, a 40% retail share, and 8-10 new stores by FY30.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: Signatureglobal, Glenmark, Ashoka Buildcon in focus
summary: Signatureglobal rallies 9% on land win and strong sales. Glenmark advances oncology pipeline with FDA IND filing. Ashoka Buildcon bags massive NHAI orders.

headline: Hexaware wins ISG Star of Excellence for 7th year
summary: Hexaware Technologies secured the 2026 ISG Star of Excellence Award in the Client Champion category, marking seven consecutive years of recognition.

headline: AI Champdany Industries receives open offer draft
summary: AI Champdany Industries Ltd received a Draft Letter of Offer for an open offer by Gunny Dealers and G Jerambhai Exports to acquire 26% equity at ₹29.50 per share.

headline: Exide Industries cuts stake in Ulric Renewables to 26.07%
summary: Exide Industries has reduced its shareholding in Ulric Renewables to 26.07% following a delay in the 10.5 MW wind project in Maharashtra.
